cards.title: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator (src/ratings/notch.mjs)
cards.context: Plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, node:test + node:assert/strict. Pure functions, no I/O (CLAUDE.md). Create src/ratings/notch.mjs with named exports: (1) RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]) (19 entries, best first). (2) notchChange(previous, current) -> integer index(current) - index(previous); positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged (never -0). (3) notchCalculator(previous, current) -> { notches, direction, wl } with exactly these keys: notches = notchChange(previous, current); direction = "downgrade" if notches > 0, "upgrade" if < 0, "unchanged" if 0; wl = 2 if notches >= 3, 1 if notches === 2, else 0 (1-notch downgrade, upgrades and unchanged give 0; Indicator 13 thresholds, C2/C3/C6). The example BBB+ -> BB+ is 3 notches, wl 2 (C2 corrects the POC's '2 notches, WL=1'). Input rule for every argument: accept only a primitive string (typeof === 'string'); normalise with value.trim().toUpperCase() (String.prototype.trim: spaces, tabs, newlines, NBSP; inner whitespace kept, so 'BBB +' is invalid); it must then equal one of RATING_SCALE. Anything else (empty, whitespace-only, unknown code, null, undefined/missing argument, number, NaN, boolean, bigint, symbol, object, array, String object, object with toString) throws RangeError. Never a TypeError, never a fallback. The RangeError message names the argument ('previous'/'current') and the rejected value; for a non-string describe it by type (typeof, or 'null') and never stringify it: a template literal with a Symbol, or String(Object.create(null)), would throw TypeError. Export the validation only if useful; card T-02 will import notchChange from this file. No eval/new Function/dynamic import, no node: imports, no console.
acceptance: AC-1: RATING_SCALE deep-equals the 19 ratings of C1 best first, length 19, Object.isFrozen true
AC-1: RATING_SCALE.push('D') and RATING_SCALE[0]='X' throw TypeError and leave the scale unchanged
AC-2: notchChange returns index(current)-index(previous) as an integer: ('BBB+','BB+')=3, ('BB+','BBB+')=-3, ('AAA','AA+')=1, ('CCC','CCC-')=1, ('AAA','CCC-')=18, ('CCC-','AAA')=-18
AC-2: notchChange('A','A') is 0 and Object.is(result, 0), never -0
AC-3: notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB') = {notches:1, direction:'downgrade', wl:0}
AC-3: notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB-') = {notches:2, direction:'downgrade', wl:1}
AC-3: notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+') = {notches:3, direction:'downgrade', wl:2} (C2 corrects the POC example)
AC-3: notchCalculator('AAA','CCC-') = {notches:18, direction:'downgrade', wl:2}
AC-4: upgrades give negative notches, direction 'upgrade', wl 0: ('BBB','BBB+')=-1, ('BB+','BBB+')=-3, ('CCC-','AAA')=-18
AC-4: notchCalculator('A','A') = {notches:0, direction:'unchanged', wl:0}, exactly three keys, not -0
AC-4: for every pair of the 19x19 scale notchCalculator.notches === notchChange and direction/wl follow the rule
AC-7: trim + case-insensitive: notchChange('bbb+','BB+')=3, notchChange('  BBB+\t','\nbb+ ')=3, notchChange('aaa','ccc-')=18, notchCalculator('\u00A0Bbb+\u00A0','bbb-')={2,'downgrade',1}
AC-8: every invalid string ('', '   ', 'BBB +', 'B B B', 'BB++', 'AAA-', 'D', 'NR', 'Baa1', full-width) in either position throws RangeError from notchChange and notchCalculator
AC-8: every non-string (null, undefined, 3, NaN, true, 10n, Symbol, {}, Object.create(null), ['BBB'], {toString}, new String('BBB')) in either position throws RangeError, never TypeError
AC-8: a missing argument (notchChange('BBB'), notchChange(), notchCalculator('BBB')) throws RangeError

notes.note: attempt 2/2 gate failed only because QA's corrected test (08a655d, qa_scope) sits in the card worktree; code (9dedde5) and QA file are correct (QA_VERIFY 75/75, unit 52/52). Needs /deliver:retry T-02 (human-granted attempts reset), then gate -> qa -> review -> integrate.

cards.context: Plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, node:test + node:assert/strict. Pure, no I/O (CLAUDE.md). Create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs whose only export is countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> number 0 | 1 | 2. It must be built on notchChange: `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs'` (delivered by card T-01). Do not copy the rating list or add a second index table. Rule (REQ-03-12, C3): n = notchChange(previous, current); return 2 if n >= 2, 1 if n === 1, else 0 (upgrades and unchanged give 0). Note C6: unlike notchCalculator (1-notch downgrade gives wl 0), Indicator 12 gives 1 for a 1-notch downgrade. Input handling comes from notchChange: trim (String.prototype.trim) + case-insensitive, e.g. (' a ','a-') -> 1. Any argument that is not one of the 19 ratings throws RangeError, never TypeError and never a fallback. Let notchChange's RangeError propagate unchanged (do not catch it, do not wrap it in another error type). No pre-fill from a public source (C4), no override parameter, persistence or audit (C7), no output (C8).
acceptance: AC-5: countryRatingChangeWl('A','A-') = 1 (1-notch downgrade; differs from the calculator's wl 0, C6)
AC-5: countryRatingChangeWl('A','BBB+') = 2
AC-5: countryRatingChangeWl('A','BBB') = 2 (3 notches)
AC-5: countryRatingChangeWl('AAA','CCC-') = 2
AC-6: upgrades ('A-','A') and ('CCC-','AAA') return 0
AC-6: unchanged ('BB','BB') returns 0
AC-5/AC-6: for every pair of the 19x19 scale the result is n>=2 ? 2 : n===1 ? 1 : 0 with n = notchChange(p, c)
AC-7: trim + case-insensitive: (' a ','a-')=1, ('\u00A0bbb\n','BB+')=1, ('aaa','ccc-')=2
AC-8: every invalid value of the plan's AC-8 list in either position, and a missing argument, throws RangeError (never TypeError)
AC-9: the module imports notchChange from '../ratings/notch.mjs', holds no rating list or index table, and exports only countryRatingChangeWl

cards.title: Restore the C1 order of RATING_SCALE (BBB- before BB+) in src/ratings/notch.mjs and pin it with a literal regression test
cards.context: Why: merge commit 84e2366 ('refactor: tidy the rating scale') went onto the job branch outside dl. It swapped BBB- and BB+ in RATING_SCALE in src/ratings/notch.mjs, so the scale now reads ...BBB+, BBB, BB+, BBB-, BB... C1 and plan AC-1 require ...BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-... Every notch count across the BBB-/BB+ boundary is wrong (notchChange('BBB+','BB+') must be 3; notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB-') must be {notches:2,direction:'downgrade',wl:1}). T-01's contract tests (test/integration/ratings/notch.contract.test.mjs) fail (26 failures in the full node --test run). Fix: restore the order and change nothing else. Do not touch notchChange, notchCalculator, validation, error messages or exports. REQUIRED CONTRACT: RATING_SCALE stays a named export built with Object.freeze([...]) and deep-equals exactly, best first: ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]. Indices: AAA 0 ... BBB- 9, BB+ 10 ... CCC- 18. Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true. Regression test: in test/ratings/notch.test.mjs add or keep a test comparing RATING_SCALE with assert.deepStrictEqual against that array written out literally in the test (not derived from the module, sorted or built in a loop). Check that the existing unit tests in test/ratings/notch.test.mjs were not changed to match the swapped order; if they were, restore the C1 values (notchChange('BBB+','BB+')=3, ('BBB+','BBB-')=2, ('AAA','CCC-')=18). Do not edit T-01's QA file test/integration/ratings/notch.contract.test.mjs; it must pass unchanged. T-02 (src/indicators/countryRating.mjs) imports notchChange; its files are outside this card's scope. Node 18+ ESM, node:test + node:assert/strict, no npm dependencies, no I/O in src/ratings. Commit as '<CARD-ID>: restore C1 rating scale order'.

cards.title: Re-deliver Indicator 12: countryRatingChangeWl in src/indicators/countryRating.mjs (from T-02 branch work)
cards.context: Why: Indicator 12 (REQ-03-12) is missing from the job branch. Card T-02 was finished, but it got blocked after using both attempts (2/2). The only reason the attempt-2 gate failed was that QA's commit, which belongs in qa_scope, ended up in the card worktree. This card re-delivers T-02 with the same contract. Starting point: the finished work is on branch job/JOB-20261021-1317-rating-notch-calculator-and-coun--T-02. Dev commit 9dedde5 holds src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs (52/52 unit tests pass). QA commit 08a655d holds test/integration/indicators/countryRating.contract.test.mjs (75/75 pass). 9dedde5 alone only changes the unit test (the AC-7 correction); the source file is in 47bf323. Bring the work over by copying only the two in-scope files from the T-02 branch tip: git checkout job/JOB-20261021-1317-rating-notch-calculator-and-coun--T-02 -- src/indicators/countryRating.mjs test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs (or cherry-pick 47bf323 then 9dedde5). Do NOT cherry-pick or commit 08a655d or any file under test/integration/: that file is QA's, and having it in the dev worktree is exactly what failed the gate last time. After cherry-picking, run the verify command again against the current job branch. T-01 and T-03 are merged, and T-03 restored the C1 scale order. Dependency: src/ratings/notch.mjs (T-01, merged; do not edit it) exports notchChange(previous, current). It returns the signed notch count (positive means downgrade, e.g. notchChange('A','A-') === 1). It trims and case-folds its inputs, and it throws a RangeError for any value that is not on the 19-rating scale, including non-strings. C1 scale, best first: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-. CONTRACT: src/indicators/countryRating.mjs has `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"`. Its only export is countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current), with no third parameter (an edited auto-filled value is simply passed in as current, per C7). It returns n >= 2 ? 2 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0, where n = notchChange(previous, current). So 0 gives 0, 1 gives 1, 2 or more gives 2, and any negative gives 0. This differs on purpose from notchCalculator's wl (C6: a 1-notch move is WL 0 there and WL 1 here). The RangeError from notchChange must propagate unchanged: do not catch it, wrap it or fall back to 0. No rating list or index table in this file, and no I/O (CLAUDE.md: pure functions in src/indicators). AC-7 CORRECTION: under the restored C1 order, countryRatingChangeWl(' bbb\n','BB+') === 2 (BBB to BB+ is 2 notches: BBB, BBB-, BB+). An earlier version of the spec pinned a different value, so check that the unit test from 9dedde5 asserts 2 and fix it if it does not. Unit tests in test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs use node:test and node:assert/strict. They cover the boundaries, the full 19x19 sweep against the rule, case and whitespace (spaces, newline, NBSP, both positions), every invalid value in AC-8 in both positions plus a missing argument via assert.throws(fn, RangeError) (never assert message text), and AC-9 by reading the source with node:fs inside the test only and checking Object.keys(await import(...)) deep-equals ['countryRatingChangeWl']. Out of scope: notch.mjs itself, pre-fill from a public source (C4), persistence or audit (C7), UI (C8), Indicator 13. Node 18+ ESM, no npm dependencies. Commit as '<CARD-ID>: Indicator 12 country rating change WL'. Spec: .work/JOB-20261021-1317-rating-notch-calculator-and-coun/specs/T-02.md (corrected).
acceptance: AC-5: countryRatingChangeWl('A','A-') === 1 (differs from the calculator's wl 0, C6); countryRatingChangeWl('A','BBB+') === 2; countryRatingChangeWl('A','BBB') === 2; countryRatingChangeWl('AAA','CCC-') === 2.
AC-6: countryRatingChangeWl('A-','A') === 0, countryRatingChangeWl('CCC-','AAA') === 0 and countryRatingChangeWl('BB','BB') === 0.
AC-5, AC-6: for every pair (p, c) of the 19x19 C1 scale, countryRatingChangeWl(p, c) is a number in {0,1,2} equal to n >= 2 ? 2 : n === 1 ? 1 : 0, where n = notchChange(p, c).

AC-7: inputs that differ only in case or in leading/trailing whitespace are accepted: countryRatingChangeWl(' a ','a-') === 1, countryRatingChangeWl(' bbb\n','BB+') === 2 (corrected under the C1 order restored by T-03), countryRatingChangeWl('aaa','ccc-') === 2.

AC-8: a RangeError is thrown (never a TypeError, never a return value) for each of these in either position: '', '   ', 'BBB +', 'BB++', 'AAA-', 'D', 'NR', 'Baa1', 'ＢＢＢ', null, undefined, 3, NaN, true, 10n, Symbol('BBB'), {}, Object.create(null), ['BBB'], { toString: () => 'BBB' }, new String('BBB'); and for a missing argument, countryRatingChangeWl('BBB'). The RangeError from notchChange propagates unchanged.

AC-9: src/indicators/countryRating.mjs contains import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs" (either quote style), contains no list of rating codes and no index table, and its only export is countryRatingChangeWl.
The card's diff touches only src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs (no file under test/integration/, no change to src/ratings/notch.mjs).
